title: Appliance Repair Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for appliance repair — service call, diagnostic, labor, parts, and refrigerator, washer or dryer repairs. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Payment due at time of service. Parts carry a 90-day warranty; labor is guaranteed for 90 days.
notes: Thank you for your business. Diagnostic fee is waived if you approve the repair. Brand and model should be listed on the work order for warranty tracking.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled appliance repair line items: service call, diagnostic, labor, parts, fridge, washer/dryer
License # field where your city or state requires one
Diagnostic-waived note plus 90-day warranty standard for repair shops

faqs.q: What should I include on an appliance repair invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number where required, the client and service address, a dated line-item list (service call, diagnostic, labor, parts), tax, and a total due. Note the parts and labor warranty and whether the diagnostic fee is waived with an approved repair.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your licensing authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
